tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and at H≤0.48, with drive and horizon increasing together. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the response reverses sign and constrains the slow component near the forecast horizon of H=21.1.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot may favor this law, but at short horizons the slow amplitude and time constant mostly enter through their ratio. A good pilot fit would not establish the forecast at H=21.1.
Denser short-horizon sampling would constrain the early rise but would not directly test the predicted late sign reversal.
